name: @switchboard-mcp/cli
stderr:
Usage: switchboard [options] [command]

Take control of what your AI coding agents can reach: see the tools and tokens
they can touch in a repo, get secrets out of plaintext config, and scope each
agent's access.

Options:
  -V, --version                      output the version number
  --cwd <path>                       resolve repo config from this directory
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  scan [options]                     See which MCP servers and tokens your
                                     agents can reach in this repo — and what's
                                     exposed.
  manifest [options]                 Print the repo-level Switchboard authority
                                     manifest.
  audit [options]                    Audit this repo's coding-agent tool
                                     authority posture.
  run [options] <command> [args...]  Run an allowed provider command with
                                     pass-scoped credentials and audit.
  import [options]                   Consolidate scattered MCP config and swap
                                     plaintext tokens for keychain refs.
                                     Reversible, with backups.
  status [options]                   Show which config and agent profiles are
                                     active in this repo.
  doctor [options]                   Check your setup and tell you the next
                                     thing to fix or run.
  next [options]                     Print the single recommended next
                                     Switchboard action for this repo.
  secrets                            Store your tokens in your OS keychain so
                                     they stay out of repo and client config.
  auth [options] <preset>            Save a provider's token (like GitHub or
                                     Vercel) into your keychain, the easy way.
  add [options] <preset>             Plan or write a guided provider setup from
                                     a safety template.
  setup [options] [preset]           Set up this machine in one command (scan,
                                     consolidate, route agent clients), or run
                                     guided provider setup with a preset.
  presets                            Inspect provider safety templates without
                                     installing providers.
  tools [options]                    List the configured Switchboard tool
                                     surface.
  authority                          Draft and validate repo-scoped tool
                                     authority maps.
  demo                               Print local Switchboard demo command
                                     sequences.
  init [options]                     Create or print a starter Switchboard repo
                                     config.
  daemon                             Manage the local Switchboard daemon.
  mcp [options]                      Serve MCP over stdio through the local
                                     Switchboard daemon.
  serve [options]                    Serve configured stdio MCP upstreams
                                     through one Switchboard MCP endpoint.
  test [options] <profile>           Test one configured stdio MCP profile by
                                     listing its tools.
  grant [options]                    Give this repo's agent a scoped pass that
                                     expires on its own.
  revoke [options] [id]              End this repo's active pass now, before it
                                     expires.
  pass|mandate                       Create and inspect the scoped passes agents
                                     work under.
  approvals [options]                Show approval requests for this repo's
                                     passes.
